$comment: Crosspoint design tokens (UX4). Starts from the Maia Mission Control palette and adds the station, live and layout tokens the Console and agent UIs need. Source of truth for docs/design/spec.md; maia-mission-control.md is kept as the palette's origin story.
name: crosspoint

accent.$comment: Chrome only: focus, selection, primary buttons, solo-on. Never station identity, never status.

status.$comment: Health and urgency only. Always a circle + a word, never colour alone.

station.$comment: Station identity, assigned once per station and remembered. Always a rounded-square swatch next to the written name (shape separates it from status circles). Validated on panel: contrast 5.3-11.4; min CIEDE2000 between stations 14.7 across normal/protan/deutan/tritan (Machado 2009, severity 1). s4 replaced Maia-draft #5fa8d3, which merged with s1 under deuteranopia (7.0).

live.$comment: My voice is going somewhere: mic button, live band, 'Hears you', 'TALKING'. Distinct from critical by hue and lightness, and always with a label or mic glyph.

breakpoints.$comment: Container widths, not viewport (the Console may live in a narrow window or a PWA).

motion.$comment: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop pulses, keep state changes instant.

rules: Accent is chrome only; station colours are identity only; status colours are health only; live is my voice only. No role borrows another's colour.
Station identity = rounded-square swatch + written name. Status = circle + word. Never colour alone.
Text always uses ink tokens, never a station or status colour (exceptions: liveInk on live surfaces, onLive on the filled live button).
Pink (live) appears only where my voice actually goes; the default open-mic state must not paint every station.
Activity shows what a station sends (pre-fader); mute and dim lower its emphasis, never hide it.
A meter is coloured only when audio is really being sent or received; grey means local level only.
Station names never truncate; secondary text (health numbers, hints) truncates first.
